technical.summary: MCK shows mixed technicals with strong trend structure (EMA 50/200, Supertrend) and positive volume signals, but momentum indicators lag price action and MACD remains bearish, limiting high-probability entry confidence.

fundamental.summary: MCK shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 9 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no actionable signal; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (379.5) with imminent FOMC event in 2 days creates severe macro headwinds; earnings in 9 days adds moderate binary risk; normal yield curve provides limited offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong trend structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Supertrend bullish) with extreme volume spike (15x) and contrarian fear-zone opportunity (VIX 379.5) suggest capitulation bottom setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: MACD remains bearish, price trades below EMA-9/SMA-21, FOMC event in 2 days creates binary macro risk, earnings in 9 days present high volatility, and zero fundamental conviction (no insider buying, no institutional accumulation) make this a low-probability entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme VIX and volume spike suggest capitulation, MACD bearish divergence, price below key moving averages, and zero fundamental conviction create unfavorable risk/reward ahead of FOMC (2 days) and earnings (9 days).
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 2 days combined with earnings in 9 days creates dual binary catalysts in crisis VIX regime; lack of insider/institutional accumulation signals low conviction from smart money.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technicals show structure but momentum lags; fundamentals and risk heavily negative; debate winner is bear with medium confidence
